candidates.pitch: Gladiator souls-like: duel three champions in the colosseum, each a different defence, to win your freedom.
Crowd favour from clean parries and taunts; at full favour the crowd throws you a heavier weapon.
Two gladiators chained wrist to wrist: every roll, bash and stagger yanks the other body too.
Colosseum duel ringed by stone walls; a parried or charged hit hurls rivals through them, and breaches stay.
Parry a heavy and the rival's weapon flies into the sand; whoever grabs it fights with its moves.

concept.why: The breach is a GIF: a punish hurls a rival through shattering stone, built on kit barrier_wall fracture. Breaches change the space for later rounds. The obvious ladder has no hook; the chain needs physics we lack.
concept.hook: parries hurl rivals through stone walls that shatter and stay broken

references.borrow: a guard break or bash into a wall splats the rival, guaranteeing a follow-up heavy
posture bar fills on blocks and parries; full posture opens a deathblow regardless of health
a charged hit at the arena edge sends the rival through the wall into a new area

pillars.rules_out: Hits that only shove, blocks without attacker recoil, parries without a stunned attacker, one-sided clashes.

pillars.line: The wall is earned, never given.
pillars.rules_out: Random collapses, breaches from plain lights, scripted destruction, walls that break without a parry or charge.

pillars.line: Skill is in the feet and the timing.
pillars.rules_out: Auto-face, lock-on aim assist, attack arcs over 50 degrees, speed-stat difficulty, hidden help.

verbs.input: Light (J): gladius cut, clip strike; chain windup 12. Blocked: attacker recoils 0.15 m, -2 safe.
verbs.cancel: Chains into light from the last 4 f of recovery; parried: attacker PARRIED 52, weapon knocked away.

verbs.input: Heavy (K): overhead, clip strike_heavy, armour f12-37; hold to charge 54/6/36, unblockable, red flash f20. Blocked: attacker recoils, -22.
verbs.cancel: Feint with Guard before f20 (6 stamina); a charged hit or post-parry heavy near a wall breaches it.

verbs.input: Bash (E): shoulder charge, clip body_check, unblockable, unparryable. Lands: GUARDBROKEN 30, pushed 1.0 m; wall within 1.2 m: WALLSPLAT 60.
verbs.cancel: Loses to any active hit and a roll; whiffed: 24 f open. A splat guarantees the follow-up heavy.

verbs.input: Guard (Shift) tap, clip block: parry window f2-13; hold becomes block 4/held/6. Parried: attacker PARRIED, weapon knocked wide.
verbs.cancel: Whiffed: 20 f open, 8 stamina; re-tap within 30 f shrinks the window by 4. Parry then heavy breaches.

verbs.input: Roll (Space + direction), clip roll: i-frames f4-21, 20 stamina; recovery f22-36 is a counter-hit window.
verbs.cancel: Beats attacks and bash, loses to a delayed heavy; starts from IDLE, BLOCK or last 4 f of recovery.

playstyles.title: Wall Breaker
playstyles.line: Armoured heavies and bashes walk rivals backwards into stone, then charge.

playstyles.title: Riposte Artist
playstyles.line: Wait, parry, and turn every punish into a hurl through stone.

playstyles.title: Sand Runner
playstyles.line: Roll through swings, punish recoveries, fight through the breached corridor.

loops.s3: Read the rival's windup, answer with parry, block or roll, then punish the opening.
loops.s30: Drain stamina and posture, steer the rival's back to a wall, land a splat or breach.
loops.m3: Win a best-of-3 in an arena your breaches reshape, then face the next champion.

context: Each breach turns a splat wall into an opening onto the narrow corridor.
Rival phase 2 under 50 % HP adds a new string.
Round 3 Emperor's Decree: any landed heavy near a wall breaches it.
Under 30 HP a fighter's parries glow and load +50 % posture.
Each ladder rival defends differently: absorb, parry, avoid.

skill.floor: Press Light to cut; Orso's slow heavy and long return teach the punish.
ceiling: Parry a light, take the guaranteed heavy while their back faces a wall: a breach.
Feint a heavy before f20 into a bash for a wall splat, then charge.
Fight in the corridor: two near walls make every bash splat and every charge breach.

feel.knockback: TLBiped.shove impulse = base + growth x damage taken; light 0.25 m, heavy 0.6 m, breach 9 m/s through the wall.
feel.reaction: Both freeze; victim TLHit.react(dir, 0.3 light, 0.7 heavy, 1.2 counter-hit); blocked attacker recoils, parried attacker staggers, weapon flung wide; TLHit.down only on charged or breach.
feel.whiff: Full recovery plays, a swish sound (TLAudio.play), no burst, stamina regen paused 20 f; the swinger stays open.
feel.shake: None on lights; heavy 0.08 over 10 f; wall splat 0.15 over 14 f; breach 0.3 over 20 f with debris.
feel.camera: Raised orbit over the player's shoulder, pitch 40, pivot between fighters, player 0.25 of frame; low walls never block the lens.

clips.moment: Livia's thrust is parried, sparks fly, the heavy hurls her through shattering stone.
Orso is bashed into the wall, splatted, then a red-flash charged hit breaks it.
Kass rolls through a heavy in the corridor, gets caught in recovery and splatted.

design.first_minute: The sand opens on Orso 4 m away, one HUD hint: 'Shift as his blade falls: parry'. His first heavy is slow; a parry leaves him open.
design.fail_state: End screen names the cause ('Parried 3 times by Livia'), breaches made and the next champion; Light restarts in 1 s.
out_of_scope: Ragdolls, jumping or climbing over walls
Gear stats or a character creator

design_reviewed.notes: No slop found; build it. Fix three gaps: breach damage reads "40 total" in the aspect but "+10 on top of the hit" in the rules, so pick one. Say whether the 1.0 m outer stones splat or breach, and what happens once all 8 segments are down. Name the 6 f input response next to the 8-frame buffer. Orso's tower shield needs its own block clip, not a plain body on his arm.

brief.pitch: Duel gladiators in a stone ring; parry or charge a hit and hurl your rival through the wall.

aspects.title: Walls That Break
aspects.line: Parry, then smash your rival through stone that stays broken.
aspects.detail: A charged hit, or a heavy within 44 f after a parry, on a rival within 1.5 m of a wall: TLFracture wakes the segment, TLBiped.shove 9 m/s, TLHit.down 45 f, 40 damage total. The gap stays all match: no splat there, an opening to the corridor.

brief.rules: A match is best of 3 rounds of 75 s against one champion (TLRules clock). A round ends at HP 0, or on a deathblow: a heavy on a BROKEN fighter (posture 100, 90 f) wins the round outright. Time out: the higher HP share wins. Core copied from DUEL-PLAYBOOK 6.1-6.5 at 60 Hz with the 8-frame input buffer: light 18/4/16 (strike, chain windup 12, 9 dmg), heavy 32/5/28 (strike_heavy, armour f12-37, feint until f20 for 6 stamina, 20 dmg), charged 54/6/36 (strike_heavy held, red flash f20, unblockable, 30 dmg), bash 14/6/24 (body_check, unblockable, unparryable), guard tap = parry f2-13, 20 f recovery on a whiff, hold = block 4/held/6 (front 120 deg, chip 10 %), roll 3/18/15 (i-frames 4-21, 20 stamina). Stamina, posture, poise tiers and EXHAUSTED exactly as 6.1. Every contact changes both bodies with hit-stop on both: light hit 5 f, heavy 9; blocked light 3 f, attacker recoils 0.15 m, -2; blocked heavy 6 f, attacker bounces 40 f, -22, light guaranteed; parried light: attacker PARRIED 52, weapon knocked wide, +44; parried heavy PARRIED 36; bash lands GUARDBROKEN 30, pushed 1.0 m; bash with an intact wall within 1.2 m behind WALLSPLAT 60, +50; clash rebounds both 20 f (heavy-heavy 30); hit in windup or roll recovery is a counter-hit (+10 hitstun, +25 % dmg); a whiff plays full recovery. THE BREACH (the twist): a charged hit, or any heavy landed within 44 f after a parry, on a fighter within 1.5 m of an intact wall segment hurls him through it: hit-stop 14 f on both, TLFracture wakes the segment, TLBiped.shove 9 m/s along the hit, TLHit.down 45 f + 30 getup (i-frames 1-20), 10 damage on top of the hit. The segment stays broken for the rest of the match; the gap no longer splats and opens the corridor. Rivals can breach the player the same way. Round 3, Emperor's Decree: any landed heavy near a wall breaches. Comeback: under 30 HP a fighter's blade glows and his parries load +50 % posture. Feel: no shake on lights, heavy 0.08/10 f, splat 0.15/14 f, breach 0.3/20 f with debris, dust, the break sound and a crowd roar. First minute: Orso 4 m away, one HUD hint, slow heavies to parry. Intensity: a calm 3 s spacing open, rival PRESS waves broken by RESET after a parry or under 30 stamina, phase 2 under 50 % HP, the decree in round 3. End screen names the cause and the next champion; Light restarts in 1 s.
brief.arena: A sand octagon 14.5 m across (apothem 7.24 m) on a ground_patch, ringed by 8 kit barrier_wall segments 6 m long and 1.2 m high, stone-tinted, pre-fractured. Behind them a 2.5 m sand corridor, closed by a kit stones row 1.0 m high; raked kit stands from 17 m radius, two flags and an entrance portal at the north gate, out of the fight. Intact inner walls splat; broken ones become 6 m openings into the corridor, where both walls are within 2.5 m, so bashes splat and charges breach more often. Breaches persist through all 3 rounds of a match; the walls are rebuilt before the next champion. Fighters start 4 m apart at the centre each round. Camera: ctx.cameras.orbit on a pivot node 35 % of the way from player to rival, pivot clamped inside 9 m radius, pitch 40 deg, distance 5-7 m, fov 50, ctx.cameras.frame(player, 0.25); right-drag turns it. Every wall is lower than the lens line at 40 deg and the stands begin beyond the camera's farthest reach (9 m + 5.4 m), so no scenery ever sits between lens and fighters; an edge arrow on TLHud marks an off-screen swing.
brief.ai: All rivals run the DUEL-PLAYBOOK 6.6 machine (SPACING at threat range +0.3 m, PRESS, DEFEND, PUNISH, RESET), seeing only visible states after react_frames, remembering the player's last 8 responses, never one string 3 times, every string ending in a return window. In PUNISH they choose a heavy when the player's back is within 1.5 m of a wall, to breach him. None stands idle over 2 s. 1) ORSO THE WALL (rung 1: react 30, defend 0.30, read 0.10, return 36): body_scale 1.25, bare-chested brute with a tall tower shield (a plain body on his arm) and a short club; poise 40, HP 120, blocks at x0.7 stamina, rarely parries. Habit: shield bash with a shoulder dip at f4; armoured heavy raised high for 32 f; guard counter after a block; taunts after 2 blocked hits. Weak to bash and stamina pressure. Phase 2 under 50 % HP: a 3-hit heavy string with one fixed 18 f delay. 2) LIVIA FERRO THE DUELIST (rung 2: react 22, defend 0.45, read 0.30, return 28): slim, normal scale, long blade, crested helmet; poise 20, HP 100, parry window 14. 3-light chain, thrust heavy, feint into bash, riposte after her own parry; parries the 3rd hit of a string, punishes every whiff, pokes at max range. Tell: taps her blade 24 f before a riposte string (hit her then for a counter-hit). Weak to delayed or feinted heavies and bashes. 3) KASS THE DANCER (rung 3: react 18, defend 0.60, read 0.50, return 22): body_scale 0.9, twin short blades, sash; poise 10, HP 85, roll 30 f (i-frames 3-18). Dash light 2.5 m, roll-attack, 4-hit flurry (12 f chains, ender -20 on block), delayed spin heavy (always a 30 f hold), taunt after a flurry; rolls through the player's heavy windup with read_p, rolls away under 40 stamina; any heavy staggers her. TITLE DEFENSE: the three again at Champion tier (react 15, defend 0.70, read 0.65, return 18), each with one new string. Reactions: a rival who breaches the player taunts (taunt clip, 60 f, hittable for a counter-hit); a rival breached roars and presses for 4 s; a beaten rival stays down while the winner plays cheer. Harder means sharper reading, defence and shorter return windows, never faster stats.
brief.controls: Move: WASD, camera-relative, also sets facing (no auto-face, attack arc 50 deg). Light: J or left mouse, strike; press again to chain. Heavy: K, tap for a heavy, hold for the charged hit. Guard: Shift, tap to parry, hold to block, pressed during a heavy windup before f20 it feints. Roll: Space with a direction. Bash: E, shoulder charge. Right-drag turns the orbit camera; Light restarts on the end screen.
brief.mood: Sun-baked inked toon arena: ochre sand, pale stone walls, red banners, a crowd that hushes on windups and roars on breaches; steel clangs, a heavy stone crack and a horn between rounds.
